notes.title: The 2nd Alpha is coming. Prepare yourself!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/48ae98f920554aca2db4cdd203a54c4539fa5e1e.png[/img]

[h2][i]LOCO universe which has been closed in the darkest world for a long time, is now awakening!
[/i][/h2]

We've come a long way from a long development to finally our 2nd alpha test.
And now it's coming!

Here is the information about the 2nd Alpha test:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/fc7a00bbdd921cca33cd32c85bd28f398c6bcd1c.png[/img]


[h1][Pre Alpha 2 Test Schedule][/h1]
From: December 20th, 15:00PM CET
To: December 23th, 23:00PM CET
Download/Patch Update will available on December 19th.
[i]Participation is limited to supporters only.[/i]
Those who supported our project will be able to first participate in the pre-alpha for 3 days!
[u]At this phase, expecting server and multi-instance program stability, game bugs and performance will be tested.[/u]


[h1][Alpha 2 Test Schedule][/h1]
From: TBA
To: TBA
[i]Participation is limited to supporters only.[/i]
After the pre-alpha 2 is over, a new date will be announced with some new content, bug fixes(if any) and balance adjustments.
[u]At this phase, expecting gameplay, contents, feedbacks, bugs and performance will be tested.[/u]


[h1][Alpha 2 Public Test Schedule][/h1]
From: TBA
To: TBA
After the limited alpha 2 is over, a new date will be announced with some new content, bug fixes(if any) and balance adjustments.
[u]At this phase, expected server load stability, database query capacity, bugs and performance will be tested.[/u]

[h1][Why testing? About the 2nd alpha test][/h1]
Well,
We run such alpha tests to know how the fruits of our development affect you, whether you experience and report fun bugs.
[i]Also the feeling of nostalgia - just like the good old times, right?[/i]

The only thing you should keep in mind in alpha tests is [u]respect[/u].

Bugs and the content itself might not be fun for you, but it's also feedback which is helps us to improving further and feeling better for you! ♥

[h1]A special reward for participation in the 2nd alpha phase[/h1]
You will get special title: [b]Alpha Soul[/b]
Color: Blue-Cyan
Time: Unlimited, Permanent
Quest: Play Alpha 2 stage 1 minutes or longer
You can active titles anytime from Achievements>Titles menu

[h1]NO NDA[/h1]
There is no NDA in each 2nd Alpha Test phases.
You're free to share, stream, record or upload to youtube. 
We appreciate any contents you create about Land of Chaos Online 2 Revolution!

[h2]Join to Community![/h2]
Do not miss next test schedules or any events!
Besides, we've gathered lots of oldschool fans in our Discord server. This is a special place where you can have fun talking to each other, discovering your teammates from the past and anticipating return of LOCO Universe. Everyone is waiting!
Discord: [url=http://discord.gg/loco2]https://discord.gg/loco2[/url]


[b]See you in the LOCO Universe~[/b]

notes.title: Dev. Letter: 1 - Starting out
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/81ae142dc72d88b7630c48e13adb538794aa8b90.png[/img]
Hello, folks in the LOCO universe community!
Welcome to the first development letter from the developers of Land of Chaos Online: II Revolution!
In this letter, will touch on many things we have been working on since the beginning of the project, our future plans and everything else.

To the LOCO community following this project, We want to start off by saying that the next alpha phase is approaching months and years of patience and excitement are about to bear fruition.
But to everyone from new readers to new players, or even those who haven't played the game for years and just heard about this project, this letter’s purpose is enlightening you about the current situation, and the full list of features and content coming in the next alpha stage update and our plans moving forward and more.

To give everyone a background story of how this project came to be; 
The game was originally released in beta by the Korean company in 2009. With each update, they made an agreement with alaplaya and released it to other countries. Everything was going well until 2011. The game had a bright future and a catchy side.
But, after the Evolution update, the development of the game was stopped by the Korean developer company after the sadness and disappointment of the players. Later, alaplaya and Japanese publishing company realized the current state of the game and created a paywall for all in-game products, and unfortunately stopped publishing after the sudden drop in player numbers.
[i]*Haste makes waste*[/i]

So the LOCO community, who missed the old version of the game after the closure, made us deeply saddened by the fact that there was no response despite many petitions, campaigns and e-mails to the developer.
Since there will be no tzatziki from Korean developers; I started the project of bringing the LOCO universe back to life alone in 2015 while high school years.
After working on unity for the first time since 2015, and 1 year later I realized that I couldn't get enough efficiency, stability, updates, and qualification with Unity. Then I started to bring the LOCO universe to life from scratch with the Unreal Engine 4 game engine.
LOCO fans who have not forgotten the spirit of LOCO after posting in-game footage on the internet over time, we started to form the new community after they're smelling this project.
[i]*The game may die but the community not*[/i]

The LOCO community is really supported a lot to us so far. We argued with some, had fun with some, laughed and cried. It means the world to me and it was a massive source of motivation. I can't thank you enough.
After it became playable a few years later, minor releases, testing, events and updates were made. Once all went well, we released the first alpha phase as public play. After finding a lot of errors and bugs after alpha, we shut down the servers to continue development in a better way.
We would like to thank everyone for the amazing feedback we have received from all of you over the course of the last couple of months,
Then, with more people knowing about this project and hopes, we started posting it on discord with development videos, WIP, feedback, new features and changes from day to week without releasing their hype.
[i]*You still can see some works and news in our discord server.*[/i]

[h1]--Gameplay--[/h1]
First and foremost, our main priority is and always will be gameplay. One of our main concerns was the balancing of the game, because equipment with a very different system from other MOBA games, 3 character selections, 10 different skill selections per character, 10 item slots, mining area capture, and many things that you will be unfamiliar with. [i](If you old LOCO player, you will not unfamiliar at all!)[/i]
So that means 2x the extra effort of a regular MOBA game. In this project you can come across a few changed parts from the old version.

[h3]*Match 3 character swaps are no longer available with P2W scrolls[/h3]
The probability of winning the game was very high for the player who was a whale in the old version. That's why we've also removed P2W stat effects from costumes that would affect the game changer.
You will now be able unlimitedly swap your character with gold you have accumulated during the match!
[previewyoutube=VkaBfOpuw24;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VkaBfOpuw24[/previewyoutube]
[i]Cost for swapping: Level*100+200 Gold[/i]

[h3]*No longer Jump Dashing bug[/h3]
[previewyoutube=4TlKcUfOvR8;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4TlKcUfOvR8[/previewyoutube]
In the previous game, you could dash by jumping and prevent stamina consumption. but since the real physics is affected in this game, it regains old speed when dash is cancelled.

[h3]*Remaking effects and skills balance[/h3]
Since there is a huge difference between the old game engine(UE2) and the current engine version(UE4), the old effects do not function in the current engine. 
While we take care to keep the same spirit by making new similar effects, it's also important to work on skill balances to bring more fluidity and fun to the game.
[previewyoutube=3ahwW-GS2Xw;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3ahwW-GS2Xw[/previewyoutube]
[u]Old Partizan's Flame Arrow, can now call Phoenix within controllable by holding LMB[/u]

[h3]*New map[/h3]
No matter how old the map of the old game was, it was not possible to make it as it was.
As I said that nothing from the old game can be transferred as it is, I did everything from scratch myself. So I made a lot of things myself, such as new monster spots, 2 different atmospheres (Force of Nature, Army Of Purgatorium), more attractive stylized graphics, and revamp characters, monsters, buildings textures&shaders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/38d6a6e1b48151842c2ed317aa33f73e28117ae4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/6311ee8063fa842e81ef63f30635e614f44273de.jpg[/img]

[h3]*Open World[/h3]
Lately I've been thinking a lot about this. I even thought of creating the lobby map as openworld, like town map.
I will work on this in the coming days. maybe it will be available in the next alpha stage. so you can interact with other players & NPC's, create groups, play the colosseum (survival pve mode) and grabbing the ranking in the arena.
Then you'll able to have premade teams, guild's, and some visual interacting in the open world map.

[h1]--Characters--[/h1]
In this project, you will see not only old characters, but also new characters that you have not seen before.
So new character can also be inserted until I add the last character.

[h3]*Unlocking[/h3]
Locked characters can now be unlocked with in-game currency, leveling up and premium currency.
[i]*Leveling a character is a bit different, and not the account level. and still experiemental. it may remove or changed after the alpha stage.*[/i]
To bring a character back to life, you give them food, teach war, gains experience. Then you will be able to enter with character into battle with full experience.
By owning the characters you do not have, you enter the war with the existing characters and give half of the XP you earn to the character you owned.
So you can be together. ♥
What about leave XP in halfway and complete rest of the XP with in-game currency? Yes, you also can do that with premium currency too.
However, the character you can owning and sharing XP is limited to only one until you cancelled or completed feeding.

[h3]*Character Physics[/h3]
Indispensable character physics will be available to all characters by available in the next alpha phase.
[previewyoutube=SblRg0rEVnI;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SblRg0rEVnI[/previewyoutube]
[i]*Due to the lack of bone structure of some characters, you may not see enough physical effects in some parts.*[/i]
I also prevented the character head accidentally going anywhere with a physical glitch xD
anyways,

[h1]--Balancing--[/h1]
As we just mentioned above, one of our main concerns was the balancing of the game. We made many interesting calculations from the equipment stat calculation to the item stat calculation.
First of all, the thing that affects these stats the most is the character stat chart.
You can see the stat multiplier chart that the character has in the upper left part of the character menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/4379afffe48d0779d5af748463fa72fd0a23204d.jpg[/img]

This means that the effects of ADC, Mage, Fighter, Asassin, Tank and Support roles of the character are different.
By default, all characters have the same stats except attack speed and ranges:
[i](Values may change until the game's full release. This is the stat used in the current alpha stage)[/i]

Attack Damage: 45
Attack Power: 45
Crit. Chance: 0
Crit DMG: 175
Armor: 60
Magic Resist: 60
HP: 500
MP: 350
HP and MP Reg.: 1
Stamina: 50 (5+1 second dashing time)
Stamina Reg: 10 (1 Second per regen dashing time)
Run speed: 800
Dash speed: 1600

and some special stats:
DMG reduction: 0
Crit Defense: 0
Monster DMG/DEF: 0
Tower DMG/DEF: 0
CDR: 0
LifeSteal: 0

I can hear you why it's not different by character.
Because as we just said, these stats are already affected by the character stat ratio(CSR).

if explained basically:
You bought a item in the match store,
Thats
ItemStat*CSR=A
A/50=B
B+ItemStat=C
C+CurrentValue= your final stat in the match.

To give another example:
You bought 100 HP item in match store with HP CSR is 4:
100HP*4=400
400/50=8
8+100=108
Then 108+500(as default HP)= You will get 608 HP total instead of 600 HP from 100HP item.

[h3]*What about equipment system?[/h3]
They just increase your character final stat per level with CSR. Not affect and related match store items at all. They are in seperately area.
Like if you equip a Glove which is gives 300 MP
That 300 MP is your latest character level(20th) stat, so if you are in 4th level you ill get 60MP total.
and if we calculate it with CSR it'll be:
1st level EquipmentStat(15)*CSR(5)=A(75)
A(75)/50=B(1,5)
B(1,5)+EquipmentStat(15)=Per level stat value (16,5) no matter recalculate at multiple levels. we doing this once time at the start for performance. and it multiplies Level * MP only when you got new level.

[h1]--Visual--[/h1]
I still improving on the old interface visuals. In terms of interface changes and ease of use that will come in the future, you can expect new interfaces that are modern and preserve the spirit of LOCO.
[previewyoutube=giH6XEX9lGQ;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=giH6XEX9lGQ&[/previewyoutube]
Tiers will be Militia I-V, Vanguard warrior I-V, Vanquisher Cavalry I-V, Land Master I-V and Lord of Dimension I-V same as LOCO on release. More tiers may come with big updates.
[previewyoutube=FggNnRSMU-g;full]https://youtu.be/FggNnRSMU-g?t=155[/previewyoutube]
In addition, when the first 2 tier stages are completed, it gives you a free character slot that you can swap character during the match.

With more over and more of visual improvement by time, you can see something in a video:
[previewyoutube=cdcc3M-HiHY;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cdcc3M-HiHY[/previewyoutube]


[h3]*Crosshairs[/h3]
Crosshair shapes now vary by character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/79d789798bc6c8e99dd6af991ae3544b6527bfc8.png[/img]

it also comes with animations specific to AI, Player and Critical hits. This way you will be able to clearly distinguish whether you are hitting the Player or the build/minion.
[previewyoutube=xv76agxy-ls;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xv76agxy-ls[/previewyoutube]

If you hit to player critical, you will see a more attractive crosshair animation.

Also, it is movement sensitive and you will see different crosshair effect when you run or dash.
[previewyoutube=Upml_o5An2Y;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Upml_o5An2Y[/previewyoutube]

[h3]*Damage, Scoreboard and announcer[/h3]

[i]Who died? who killed, how many damage?
Who's fighting with who, what's going on?[/i]

I've added some unobtrusive, easy-to-see death and announcement animations to understand exactly what's going on in the game.
[i]*Now everyone will be able to experience the sadness and excitement when one of your team dies or kills in your match.*[/i]
Here are previews of the ingame and scoreboard layouts:
[previewyoutube=0W0CcLORxGM;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0W0CcLORxGM[/previewyoutube]

[h1]--Performance--[/h1]
My mission is make the game as playable as possible with any hardware.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/3e477d7fb7db147a49c41666ae4c1a3a8a4461f5.png[/img]
The game has received countless optimizations and improvements, It has become almost playable even on mobile phones.
However, we were disappointed recently that Unreal Engine 4 has [u]discontinued[/u] 32-bit support. So, we will not be able to build the game for 32-bit systems unfortunately.
If you still have 4GB ram, you can upgrade to 64 bit and play! This game has low ram usage. (May change usage until game's full release.)
In addition, we took care for not to make changes in the graphics settings that would affect the game and the player.
[i]*Like; you hide in the grass but on the opposite low graphics setting the player can easily see you*[/i]
Plus, I've added a few setting to lower the hardware temp and reduce the power when you're in the background or under the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/9673c2868f8c5879679b1f04e6ed587d47416307.png[/img]


[h1]--Networking/Server and hacking--[/h1]
Let's come to the part of the game where it is the most difficult and complex as a [b]black hole[/b].
How its complex? yes, yes lets see how it feels like:
[previewyoutube=W1uV1ri0w-s;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W1uV1ri0w-s[/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=FggNnRSMU-g;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FggNnRSMU-g&t=6s[/previewyoutube]

Well, Mostly all MMO games have servers where the player will distribute their position, movement, attack/skills, character data and status to other players. Unlike the others we do, we use the server simulation that we call the player simulation that comes with UE4.
So, any changes you make in-game that affect others and the game will be rejected as soon as they reach the server.
Imagine: You pressed a skill, then hack the skill cooldown by multiplying game time for fast reduction. After cooldown is done, you still not able to press that skill again. Because in the server side, your skill is still in CD.
Same for movement hacking: When you pressing a movement button, it actually move your characters on the server side. So whenever you exceed the speed of light by multipyling delta time, the server will recognize that your movement is above the limit and will return it to its previous position.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/255074cbb94507c0636c99c72349e4a84acfb8ec.png[/img]

In the first alpha tests, this was a bit of a strain on the servers. sometimes it would cause the not to close exactly match or get stuck in a infinite loop causing the game to freeze.
Therefore, although it makes most of the server cost, we were able to reduce this cost with sufficient optimization and bug fixes.
[i](Left unoptimized - Right optimized)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/2065e4cf3f78a6ae8a3f8f58ea5e17dda6f2ab3c.png[/img]
So i'm sure next alpha stage will work well with a lot bug fixes and optimizations



[h1]--Music&Ambient&SoundFX--[/h1]
Since I was 2 years old, I can't distinguish some sounds because I've been deaf after having a seizure. I left the audio stuff for last so maybe I can find someone who can help.
[i]*Thank to my friends who helped me.*[/i]

Here is some nostalgic sounds you can hear:
[previewyoutube=giH6XEX9lGQ;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=giH6XEX9lGQ[/previewyoutube]
You may think some sounds are not the same as the old game. i used different tones to make the sounds similar to keep up with the todays modern and the game theme.
I Still looking a Sound FX maker to make other skill, hit, Interface SFX's, so not completed yet.
Here also you can listen some SoundTracks:
[previewyoutube=EhxCPjTMba8;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EhxCPjTMba8[/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=FosFmZYfhho;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FosFmZYfhho[/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=9FDJxkCvdUs;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9FDJxkCvdUs[/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=vMckcq-niME;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vMckcq-niME[/previewyoutube]


This letter was a brief summary of what I've been working on so far.
More will be available in the next letters or announcements!
I hope you've had a wonderful vacation this summer!
Stay tuned and make sure you join the Discord and follow the WIP-Announcement channel for more updates and previews in the coming days.
See you soon again! ♥

Firstly,
[h1]Merry Christmas everyone![/h1]

A new Land of Chaos online II: Revolution in the new year!
Aside from the game's out, we have been doing a few reworking of the LOCO universe recently.
Some new content you may likely see:
New Interfaces,
New character designs,
New stories,
New sounds,
And character model&animation rework with [b]same spirits[/b]! [i]I'm so excited.[/i]

[olist]
[*] [h2]New interfaces and sounds[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/43bdb0e1bb4ec666a16553e321bea174939aded4.png[/img]

Recently I tried some new interface spots with new sound effects, Although its functions are working for now, new designs will be made on it!

So till [b]10 january[/b] i did much things to make stability game and implement some systems for more fun!

[h2]Then let me post these patch notes:[/h2]

[i]in this alpha stage: Everyone's complaining about: [b]"dynamic of the game is very slow."[/b] I know that map is too big but also we need break [b]law of physics[/b]. and [u]did[/u].[/i]

[h1]So[/h1]

[olist]
[h2][b][*]All minions are speedster![/b][/h2] 
[i]Like barry allen[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/0603928d2211b58d51a21774067a3045a2a1f849.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Removed Non-Enemy Base Speed
[*] Buffs Base Speed: 460> 750
[*] Buffs Tower damage reduction 20>95 (to converted percent: %37 depends damages.)
[*] Fixed Purgatorium Ranger attacks doesn't show arrow and give damage.
[*] Adjusted minions socializing AI
[/list]

[h2][b][*]All character stats has been rebalanced[/b][/h2] 
[h3][i]With standard stats:[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Nerfs Dash Speed: 1800,0>1600,0
[*] Buffs Run Speed: 750,0>875,0
[*] Buffs Stamina: 25>30
[*] Buffs Stamina Regen. : 1,0>3,0
[*] Buffs Stamina Regen. multiplier With running: 0,5>0,7 
[*] Added All elemental defenses: 0>65
[*] Added All elemental damage: 0>40
[/list]

[h3][i]Partizan:[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased speed arrows: 5000>9000 Velocity
[*]Deadly Rain ultimate skill are improved for CC's: Fire arrows into the sky to do cause a massive rain of arrows that do 60/90% Movement Slow instantly and (50/65) + (ShadowDMG%10/15} + {FireDMG%15/20}) damage every 0.5 seconds for 7/10 seconds.
[b]+While casting, gain skill immunes.[/b]
Casting time: 1.3 Second.
[/list]

[h3][i]Hibachi:[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed speed Shurikens: 5000>(6000/8000) velocity [b]depends distances[/b].
[*] Disabled Skill, Secret of Spiders: in this alpha stage matches, this skill has much bugs. so mechanism will change in the next update.
[*] Nerfed Skill, Shadow arrest: Destroy time: 50>30
[/list]

[h3][i]Stella:[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed Back Edge Strike skill mech:
Back Edge Strike is an offensive ability in which Stella strikes her enemy with the dull edge of her sword,  knockback them and rendering them unable to cast skills and attacks for 3/4.2/5.7 seconds in addition to causing 30/50/80(+{WindDMG})damage. 
[b]+For minions and jungle monsters, it will stun.[/b]
[strike][b]-if you use any skill or attacks while casting, it automatically cancel skill.[/b][/strike]
Casting time: 1.25> 1 Second.
[/list]

[h2][b][*]System Implements&Changes&Fixes[/b][/h2] 
[h3][i]Core of the game[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed In game Market rules: All items have limitations to buy. you cant buy more than max limitation.
[i]Otherwise how could you buy 10 boots and wear them ːsteamfacepalmː[/i]
[*] Changed Queue design. Also added counter for how many player are queued.
[*] Implemented Reward system. 
[*] Implemented Leveling and open slot. (These 2 locked slots opens when you reach 6 and 11 level.)
[*] Changed movement system (There no more W+W for dashing, only can Shift+W for dash.)
[*] Fixed Towers Health and Dead bugs
[*] Fixed effect isn't correct when you got jungle buffs.
[*] Fixed Auto graphics setting error when you trying first run game.
[*] Implemented camera shake value option in settings.
[*] Implemented Fps limit option for save power consuming in setting when backgrounded game
[*] Changed damage fonts and size. also removed others damage texts.
[*] Implemented CC's text. it will show when you got CC or to someone.
[*] Changed all AI's healths per tier lane. 
[olist]
[*]Tier1 Towers: 5.000 HP
[*]Tier2 Towers: 8.500 HP
[*]Inhibitor Guardians : 9.000 HP
[*]Inhibitors : 10.000 HP
[*]Base Guardians: 5.000 HP
[/olist]
[*] Fixed match stucks when you leaving the game during loading. 
[*] Fixed Character model combining bugs. 
[h3]And MORE! (i cant remember all what i did fixed or added things right now. but you can find them that what i did. Also i will change this page when i remembered. No worries.)[/h3]
[/list]
[h1]Last: [EVENT] Added a easter egg and hidden gate![/h1]
[i][h3]If you find it, you will earn 200 diamons![/h3][/i] [b][h3]Good Luck everyone♥[/h3][/b]
[u][b]Dont forget to take ScreenShot and post to our discord.[/b][/u]
[/olist]

notes.title: Land of Chaos Online II: Revolution Alpha Stage and updates!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/e40700d21a5d8ca4c13f38bf9c6c96253f3c86a8.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]                      (MERRY CHRISTMAS)[/b][/h1]

[i]So there much has improved since the previous patch. New character, new jungle system, new graphics, props, animation and effect AND A PUBLIC ALPHA STAGE FOR [b]FREE TO PLAY[/b]!.[/i]
[b]Are you ready for playing?[/b]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/488852810579050497.gif[/img]
[h3]Let me post about new character and updates:[/h3]
[i]i'm exciting[/i]
[list]
[*][h1][b]New character: Partizan[/b][/h1]
[list]
[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/3cf98e2108596b0848bac75c633274d23eca6fae.png[/img]
             Member of Sisters of Darkness.[/h2]
[*]History: [i]Arrows of death have been impressed by darkness, sisters of darkness who were not known on the outside were capable of instilling the greatest fear and trust to anyone who knew their existence. People who were capable as her target needed to have a fear of death, and to the sisters a suitable defense was needed because Partizan could achieve her purpose.
Partizan who had the most excellent bow skill among the sisters of darkness, had her arrows write a letter of invitation of death to unlucky foes.[/i]
[/list]
[*] Skills:
[olist]
[*][h3][b]Chain Killer Arrow[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/23f0b482ff55c62a665f81009214b75ff878dfab.png[/img]
Folds the number of arrows [b]3/4/5[/b] within [b]4/5/7[/b] Seconds.
[u]Also you can't move until the arrows run out.[/u]
[b]Mana: 50/60/80[/b]
[b]CD: 14/13.5/12[/b]
[b]Upgrade levels: 1/3/6[/b]
[b]Preview: [/b]
[previewyoutube=D4GX5mfI3NQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][h3][b]Illusion Dance[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/85154cb4710805b50712728e680d86205bfd5e2f.png[/img]
You become invisible and increase ([b]30/40/50% + ShadowDMG%15/20/30[/b]) damage reduction for [b]4/5/6.5[/b] seconds.
[b]Mana: 40/50/60[/b]
[b]CD: 17/16/14[/b]
[b]Upgrade levels: 2/4/7[/b]
[b]Preview: [/b]
[previewyoutube=cNCJi3HUTo0;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][h3][b]Phoenix Arrow[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/5b16647f8441eaf2a1a7fe7c882dc3f6a0104948.png[/img]
Shoot phoenix arrow to target and inflict ([b]20/30/45/60 + FireDMG%25/30/35/45[/b]) fire damage every second for [b]4/5/6/7[/b] seconds.
[b]Mana: 70/75/84/98[/b]
[b]CD: 24/23/21/19[/b]
[b]Upgrade levels: 3/5/6/7[/b]
[b]Preview: [/b]
[previewyoutube=hUs4b2OHeUs;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][h3][b]Kill, Crush and Destroy[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/15cf9d922c6928d0bdbfd98f730609095913cbec.png[/img]
Focus firing power to get [b]25/30/36/48%[/b] increase in shadow attacks and [b]+350[/b] range. [u]but -30% to all defense[/u] for [b]5/5.4/6.5/7.7[/b] seconds.
[b]Mana: 60/70/80/95[/b]
[b]CD: 21/20/19/17.5[/b]
[b]Upgrade levels: 4/6/9/13[/b]
[b]Preview: [/b]
[previewyoutube=SCDVQpsq3tY;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][h3][b]Deadly Rain[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/b44c3c514d2547d9271b14f08dce1728110b8804.png[/img]
Fire arrows into the sky to do cause a massive rain of arrows that do [b]60/90%[/b] Movement Slow instantly and [b](50/65) + (ShadowDMG%10/15} + {FireDMG%15/20})[/b] damage every [b]0.5[/b] seconds for [b]7/10[/b] seconds.
[b]Mana: 130/150[/b]
[b]CD: 120/100[/b]
[b]Upgrade levels: 5/10[/b]
[b]Preview: [/b]
[previewyoutube=D4lSN5y-SaQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[/olist]

[*] Tips:
To playing partizan, you can use some combo skills like Kill, Crush and Destroy and chain killer arrow.
[previewyoutube=1M6FORCkBY0;full][/previewyoutube]

Also you can attack while invisible. 
[previewyoutube=yY-cRXHFjnw;full][/previewyoutube]

So partizan is intense to the element of [b]fire and shadow[/b]. of course defensive is too low for all element. you need to make strategy to do not die while using some movement restriction skills.

[h3]Are you excited to play Partizan?![/h3]

well.. me too, but need for wait public alpha stage..[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/598140901721899013.gif[/img]

[*][h1][b]New Items[/b][/h1]
Some items are been removed, new items added in game shop for strengthen yourself.
[olist]
[*][h3][b]Nethersbane[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/efcf01f440ad501f84a2d9df9becf23811410ef6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Increases attack speed +25
[/list]

[*][h3][b]Quilted Sprinters[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/4b46084fd61925fc9770c69fcc091b6590310fd0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Increases max stamina +40 
[*] Increases stamina regen +%0.5
[/list]

[*][h3][b]Battleworn Wool Feet[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/2eaff1f4dd6531a875f00558654589acbc8546ad.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Increases run speed +75 
[*] Increases dash speed +100
[/list]

[*][h3][b]Furious Iron Hands[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/5207bc0af004f9f4e24d4cacb0e943bc66d3b14f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Increases all elemental defense +30
[/list]

[*][h3][b]Defiled Eye Orb[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/bb376e25b5826644068d92e7d65715706dde15c4.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Increases all elemental attacks +35
[/list]

[*][h3][b]Astra's necklace[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/21857b042134ddb81b4f1ced64a336b90e5472e7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Increases health +150
[*] Increases mana +100
[/list]

[*][h3][b]Embroided Gloves[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/245c2cb7c438e507ff4f2dc8933daa4756422e17.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Increases Critical Chance +15
[/list]

[*][h3][b]Dire Defender[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/c1bf073fa9af0157822f3ebc7392eb97807a1d9d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Increases Critical Chance Defense +10
[*] Increases HP +200
[/list]

[*][h3][b]Hungering Ward[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/7b52c275d5115c9ea5cd114ba565210fab3880d6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Decrease monsters damage %7
[/list]

Also removed all OP items for that testing over stats (Orbs). 
it was excepted to be no bug, because of calculations never will do mistake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/6ce175eb9028ab9607c79d685f1991b9de8248cb.jpg[/img]
[/olist]

[*][h1][b]New Jungle monsters and buffs.[/b][/h1]
I was uploaded a video jungle monsters with new partizan character week ago.

[previewyoutube=BoUaxzhgvF4;full][/previewyoutube]
That effects and character is so good [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655512434257297458.gif[/img]

[b]Also, monsters always spawn after 300 seconds after the monster die. [/b]

[*][h1][b]New Crosshair system and recalling HUD effect.[/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=AhnAI-rBA8A;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally has been changed the crosshair FX. In [b]critical attacks[/b] bigger and [b]uncriticals [/b] shows small FX .
Also, to recognize between player and AI, it shows [b]minimize FX[/b] for AI (minions,tower,monsters etc.)
At the end of the video, changed the Recalling interface to [b]circle FX[/b]

[b][u]Dont forget: All characters have different crosshair style. [/u][/b]

[*][h1][b]And last: System add, changes and fixes.[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]All Minions base speed has been increased again.:
[list]
[*]Non-Enemy Base Speed: 395>460
[*]To Enemy Base Speed: 495> 500
[/list]
[*]Completed jungle system mechanism.
[list]
[*]When you approach them, They can prepare with Enemy In Sight animation and looking you to till you attack or go away from them.
[*]They have 2 melee attacks and 1 range attacks(it depends jungle monsters.)
[*]They drop a buff after death(may vary according to monsters.), and gives EXP + GOLD to you and who helped to kill them.
[*]Buffs have 60 second cd. Only can take buffs which team's killed the monster.
[/list]
[*]Hibachi's will lose control shirukens after death.
[*]Fixed Stella's combat bug for teleporting to base.
[*]Fixed All AI's Animation bugs after changed character.
[*]Fixed Resurrection Timer after death.
[*]Fixed Devil Ranger Minion do not make damage.
[*]Fixed some HP User Interfaces from AI's.
[*]Fixed some AI's doesnt show death animation.
[*]Added new death effect for reality.
[/list]
[/list]

And...

[h1]Land of Chaos Online II: Revolution Alpha Stage is coming in 10 January 2020![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211290
[list]
[*] How to join
[list]
[*] First: Add to your list,
[*] Second: Wait for it..,
[*] And Third: Enjoy it!
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]Thats all! Thank you for reading and participating to alpha stage![/b][/h3]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547645303529144339.gif[/img]

See ya in alpha stage~

(Note: the patch notes, may be change till 10 january.)

notes.title: [UPDATE]-Patch v0.4
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/UokiPZVkCAzEGc5PJm/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Much has improved since the previous patch. And much will be improving. Thanks to our Community! [/b]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/585140195398254642.gif[/img]
[h1]So, first I want to share game updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added an new tutorial system as you can see from the gif at the top og this page.
[*]All character's base speed has been increased:
[list]
[*]Base Speed: 600 > 750
[*]Dash Base Speed: 1600 > 1700
[*]Base Stamina: 20>25
[/list]
[*]All Minion's base speed has been increased:
[list]
[*]Non-Enemy Base Speed: 305>395
[*]To Enemy Base Speed: 416> 495
[/list]
[*]Hibachi's Secret of Spider skill got reworked about functions and effects. (No longer screen animation) and Functions are renewed again.
[*]Some networking optimizations
[*]Movement functions are renewed (New function is experinmental. if you see some weird movement and animation. Show us with screenshot or video.)
[*]Stun effect wasn't removed after the end of it's effect.
[*]Mana and stamina will be full after death.
[*]Some chat functions are fixed.
[/list]
[h1]Nerfs:[/h1]
[u][b]Hibachi[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Kidney Shot: Throw a shuriken to hit a vital point and paralyze the enemy. The paralyzed enemy cannot attack and use skills for 5/6/8 3/4/5 Seconds. Can be used on enemies with skill immunity.
[/list]
[h1]Then, Second thing: Road-Map![/h1]
[i]I can't see very distant future, but I can predict what will happen this month.[/i]
[b]09.2019 Estimated coming future content:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Match statistic system.
[*]Jungle system completing.
[*]New character: Partizan
[*]New character: Lacrimosa
[*]Lobby Shop system.
[*]Reward system.
[*](WIP)Rework in game Shop system.
[*]Adding some props in game(grass,rocks or more) its depend to my pc power.
[/olist]
[b]Also new loading card style coming soon! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176521/38200c6347359a9b97ee9155be7deb559be80292.png[/img]
[i]That's really a nice remade, right?[/i]

[h1]Last, Patreon page has been published for supports![/h1]
[url=https://www.patreon.com/loco2]Link: https://www.patreon.com/loco2[/url]

[i][b]Why i did open a patreon page?[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Cause i am developing this game only me. So, solo working is hard to me with old PC, compiling, building and for more quality textures.
[/list]
[i][b]Can i get tester key with one time support?[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Actually yes, also if you want to support me with custom value; you can do it on to my paypal page.
[/list]
Thats all!
If you still interesting more FAQS for this game, [url=https://discord.gg/loco2]you can join our discord server: https://discord.gg/loco2[/url]
